text:
Ari Tan: Quick thought 
Rooftop Vinyl Swap + Bagel-Maker Challenge next Thu 7pm? casual, bring a record to trade and your best bagel topping idea. :musical_note: :bagel:
Mira Shah: omg yes i have so many 90s CDs vinyls that need homes. count me in. :raised_hands:
Liam O'Connor: bagel-maker challenge?? explain the rules please. are there judges? :thinking_face:
Tess Rivera: simple rules: 1) bring a topping/container of something to put on a bagel 2) each person makes a mini-bagel for judges 3) two rounds (sweet + savory). losers buy cream cheese for next event. :grin:
Noel Park: ill bring a portable toaster and jam sampler. also can DJ mellow lo-fi vinyl between rounds.
Ari Tan: @Tess perfect. @Noel thanks for toaster. thinking we cap at 18 people so it stays cozy. can ppl RSVP here (quick yay/nay)?
Mira Shah: yay (veg)
Liam O'Connor: yay (egg allergy)
Tess Rivera: yay (gluten-free bagels ok?)
Noel Park: yay
Ari Tan: GF bagels noted. tiny signup so we can collect topping ideas: https://tinyurl.com/rw-vinyl-bagel-swap
PartyBot: Event created: "Rooftop Vinyl Swap & Bagel Challenge" Thu 7:00PM  invited: #lunch-plans.
Ari Tan: budget: $5 suggested to cover bagel extras + disposable plates. volunteers for setup/cleanup?
Mira Shah: i can help setup at 6:30 and bring serving tongs.
Liam O'Connor: ill help with teardown until 8:45.
Tess Rivera: poll: should we have a tiny prize for the bagel champ? 1) quirky sticker 2) bagel crown 3) coupon for local bakery
Mira Shah: 2
Liam O'Connor: 3
Noel Park: 1 (stickers are underrated)
Ari Tan: leaning sticker + small ribbon. will grab a pack of novelty stickers.
Ari Tan: copyable checklist for folks who want it:
```
- one record to swap (label it if you want it back)
- topping or spread (enough for ~6 mini bagels)
- $5 suggested contribution (Venmo link posted Wed)
- reusable plate or napkin if youre into sustainability
- any small utensils (spreader, tongs)
```
Mira Shah: can someone bring a small speaker cable adapter? my turntable uses RCA and the rooftop speaker is aux-only.
Noel Park: ill bring an RCA->aux adapter and backup Bluetooth dongle.
PartyBot: Reminder scheduled: 24h before event -> "Vinyl & Bagel final headcount" in #lunch-plans.
Ari Tan: last ask  who wants to be a judge (two judges per round)? will rotate so folks can also taste.
Tess Rivera: i can judge sweet round.
Liam O'Connor: ill judge savory.
Mira Shah: happy to be a backup judge.
Ari Tan: awesome. ill post venmo link Wed and final headcount Thu morning. see you on the roof! :sparkles:
